اعتزمت (form VIII)
# اِعْتَزَمْتُ (iʕtazamtu) /iʕ.ta.zam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
# اِعْتَزَمْتَ (iʕtazamta) /iʕ.ta.zam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
# اِعْتَزَمْتِ (iʕtazamti) /iʕ.ta.zam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
# اِعْتَزَمَتْ (iʕtazamat) /iʕ.ta.za.mat/: third-perso
